node.title: Re: How do I tell if my code is using JSON::PP or JSON::XS?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
When I do Data::Dumper on some data, I’m seeing ‘JSON::PP::Boolean’ for the true/false values. Is that confirmation that the code uses PP or might that be a red herring?

It's a red herring: [mod://JSON], [mod://JSON::XS], [mod://Cpanel::JSON::XS], [mod://JSON::PP], and [mod://Mojo::JSON] (and possibly more that I've missed) all use [doc://JSON::PP::Boolean] to represent their boolean types.
